items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore ruled OUT TNF shoulder injury (AC joint sprain); doctors not serious, day-to-day with chance (not lock) for next week vs Chargers.
items.why: Hard landing on shoulder; X-rays/stinger then OUT; AC sprain confirmed.
items.implication: Missed TNF; monitor for Week 3 availability; short-term depth chart shift.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thursday; unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Bowers also DNP again post-knee surgery.
items.why: No practice Wed/Thu after Week 1 rib injury; Bowers yet to practice since meniscus trim.
items.implication: McConkey high miss risk; Bowers fringe for Week 2.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris elevated routes (90%+ without McConkey in W1).

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight); Ja'Kobi Lane IR/return (wrist). If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after Week 1 aggravation; Lane already IR.
items.implication: Prepare replacements; Bateman flex candidate if Flowers sits vs Saints.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. DNP Thursday after limited Wednesday.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice; history of multi-game misses; MRI/docs optimistic long-term but short-term risk.
items.implication: High risk of missing or limited Week 2; monitor Friday practice/report closely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated routes/targets for Hutchinson/Boutte (prior 29/27 routes on 42 dropbacks).

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson full practice and 'ready to go' for debut; unclear snaps vs Stevenson but timing perfect with AJ Brown IR and soft upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Full participant + self-report ready; Pats need explosives post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Volatile FLEX/handcuff upside; Stevenson still lead but share expandable.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down/explosive plays available with Brown out.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 24% target share (tied lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; Indy gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Elite early volume + receiving in new offense; soft matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season potential if healthy.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in Kubiak debut (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Near-max utilization + workhorse traits confirmed early.
items.implication: Elite RB1 start vs LAC; trust the role.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Plus streaming notes.
items.why: Direct injury fallout mappings for available players.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for role expansion.
items.opportunity: Immediate snap/target bumps for listed backups.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. Utilization top-10.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes/RZ; strong matchup.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; Bears allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite target share + historical chemistry + soft secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to NYJ; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Strong volume/depth + favorable matchup post-W1 bounce-back potential.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; 8.5 underdog script bad for rushing.
items.why: Committee + return of Kamara + tough matchup/script.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; prefer Miller stash if Kamara limited.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% routes (highest last year), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9); top-5 TE util. Colston Loveland 89% routes (league-high TE) despite 0 pts—buy low if seller panics.
items.why: Expanded roles confirmed; efficiency + volume path for both.
items.implication: Kincaid TE1 start vs DET; Loveland hold/buy.
